name: fling
description: Publish HTML pages, zips and folders from your computer to fling.labs.nearform.com and get a link back.
long_description:
Fling hosts static sites for Nearform staff at https://<name>.fling.labs.nearform.com (private to Nearformers unless you make them public or share a link).

This extension runs on your computer, so Claude can publish:

- content it created in the conversation (sent inline — no sandbox uploads),
- a file you downloaded or Claude Desktop saved, by name: it looks in Downloads, Desktop, Documents/Claude and Claude Desktop's output folders,
- a single .html file, a .zip of a site, or a folder with index.html.

Sign in once with your Nearform Google account (Claude can start it with the fling_login tool, or run `fling login` in a terminal after `npm install -g @nearform/fling`). The login is shared with the fling CLI.
